title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
label: Breaking news

scenes.say: Nvidia's founder and CEO, Jensen Huang, just resigned. Effective immediately.
scenes.credit: Photo: Peter Dasilva, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
title: NVIDIA'S CEO
RESIGNED

scenes.say: He co-founded the company in nineteen ninety three, and ran it for thirty three years.
scenes.label: leading Nvidia

scenes.say: Colette Kress, the chief financial officer, is now interim CEO. Harvey Jones becomes the company's first ever board chair. And the search for a permanent CEO has started.
title: WHO'S IN CHARGE

scenes.say: Nvidia has not said why. Reports point to a week of pressure, and Huang has agreed to answer Congress by Thanksgiving, according to the House Foreign Affairs chair. Those details are reported, not confirmed.
title: CONFIRMED
VS REPORTED

scenes.say: Shares fell more than ten percent in early trading, then recovered to about four percent down, according to CNBC.
Third quarter results are still due on Tuesday, the seventeenth of November. That call is the first test for the interim CEO.
title: WHAT TO WATCH
scenes.label: Earnings call, the interim CEO's first

scenes.say: My take: hold off on big hardware decisions until after that call. Full sources are on my blog. Follow for the news that matters, every day.
title: NEWS THAT MATTERS
EVERY DAY
